evidence_format: ZIP member path, SHA-256 of uncompressed member, JSON pointer; pointers name data observations, not verified executable behavior

findings.title: Wood has parallel gathering, processing and settlement production data edges
findings.prerequisite: boreal forest wood resource or a Woodcutter building; processing path requires a Pine Log
findings.decision: Select a log source and a downstream conversion route
findings.expenditure: Carpenters production entry takes one Pine Log; entity producer definition lists 30 time for direct processing
findings.mutation: Data declares Pine Log 2092 to Pine Wood 2093 outputs; it does not prove stock movement or production scheduling
findings.time: Woodcutter output daily 1; Carpenters output daily 10; log producer time 30 (units unverified)
findings.failure: No runtime shortage, queue or worker behavior recovered
findings.aftermath: Pine Wood is a type-3 resource with quality 1 and value 200 in the demo data

findings.title: Skill milestone points to a concrete ingot recipe and ore input
findings.prerequisite: Adventuring skill 48 in milestone definition; recipe requires two Adamantine Ore 2113 and tool 10
findings.expenditure: Two ore units, tool 10, recipe time 2 (units unverified)
findings.mutation: Milestone reward names recipe 2116; entity 2116 defines ingot resource quality 4 and value 60000
findings.failure: The executable's unlock enforcement, craft failure and material consumption have not been read
findings.aftermath: The output data identifies ingot 2116, with type-1 resource metadata

findings.title: Pyromancy skill, milestone and Fireball ability form a progression chain
findings.prerequisite: Ball of Fire milestone requires Pyromancy skill 15; Fireball definition assigns skill core_2_pyromancy
findings.decision: Unlock and use Fireball as a Pyromancy action in the data model
findings.expenditure: Ability cost stamina 10; cast_time 1.2 and cooldown 5 (units unverified)
findings.mutation: Ability effects declare fire damage [4,8], area range 6 and magic-power damage factor 0.25
findings.failure: Target validation, actual damage formula and combat resolution are native-code gaps
findings.aftermath: Skills data lists ability use as Pyromancy experience source at rate 2; runtime application unverified

findings.title: Four elemental core conversion recipes form a directed data cycle
findings.prerequisite: Possess one next-element core and tool 15
findings.decision: Choose conversion: Water to Fire, Wind to Water, Earth to Wind, or Fire to Earth
findings.expenditure: One core input and time 30 per recipe
findings.mutation: Each craftables entry names a distinct output prototype among IDs 2531 to 2534
findings.failure: No execution or conservation rule verified; recipe discovery and availability are unknown
findings.aftermath: Each resulting core has distinct resource affix and damage type metadata in its entity definition, but conversion effects are not observed in play
